name: codex-thunderbird
description: Codex Plugin for Thunderbird mail access.

interface.shortDescription: Local Thunderbird mail access for Codex.
interface.longDescription: Expose Thunderbird accounts, folders, messages, tags, attachments, and local sorting rules to Codex through a paired Thunderbird extension. Start with start_pairing, then use get_status and get_capabilities to discover the available commands. Thunderbird owns mailbox permissions through Manage allowed accounts, so blocked accounts are redacted in list_accounts and rejected by mail commands.
defaultPrompt: Pair Thunderbird with Codex using start_pairing.
Show Thunderbird command categories with get_capabilities.
